title: Stylish Shop Auto-Prune
description: Adds a per-category 'Remove items at 0 stock' toggle to the Stylish Shop config UI. When a flagged category has an item whose stock reaches a finite 0 (e.g. a sold-back item that fully sells through), that entry is removed instead of lingering as an out-of-stock listing. System-agnostic; requires the Stylish Shop module.
